items.text: People with strong visual and spatial skills, meaning they picture shapes, layouts and how parts fit together, can build careers in architecture, product and graphic design, CAD and engineering drawing, animation, mapping and surveying, photography and film, and the key is to turn that ability into a portfolio that others can see.
Choose a field where you can produce visible work, make three portfolio pieces and test them with real feedback from people in that field.
Check live notices for the tools employers ask for and use student licences or free versions.
